name: FlyupMem
description: Local-first, zero-cost memory system for AI agents. Four-layer hierarchy (Engram → Observation → Mental Model → Experience), multi-path recall (BM25 + semantic + graph + temporal), and automatic consolidation.

autoLearn.description: Auto-extract engrams after each conversation turn

autoRecall.description: Auto-inject relevant memories before each LLM call

autoDecay.description: Run batch decay and maintenance on startup

embeddingEnabled.description: Enable semantic search via embedding model
